scope: Theorem 7.8 (Moment identification and the full field law) of the manuscript “Gaussian free-field limits of weighted integer Lipschitz heights” (preprints/Gaussian-free-field-limits-of-weighted-integer-Lipschitz-heights-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 232 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3dae0156982e5d20), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 69. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every j ≥ 2 and distinct x, y2, . . . , yj ∈ D, Tj(x, y2, . . . , yj) = v j X i=2 GD(x, yi) Tj−2(y2, . . . , b yi, . . . , yj). (7.16) Together with T0 = 1 and T1 = 0, this identifies every moment distribution with that of √ v ΦD. Every subsequential field limit has that law. Consequently hδ/ √ v converges to ΦD as a random distribution, with joint convergence of every finite collection of smooth compactly supported pairings.
